name: 鹿鼎天下II
group_note: Sibling of ldtx (same Century/adm-single family, same architecture, largely different content -- not a duplicate). WASM pass: fixed the classic §8.1 GBK byte-range bug in adm/simul_efun/chinese.lpc's is_chinese() (str[0] > 160 && str[0] < 255 -- a GBK leading-byte check that rejects every real Chinese character on this driver, since Chinese codepoints are 0x4e00-0x9fff, far above 255; replaced with the correct codepoint-range check). Also gutted adm/daemons/network/dns_master.lpc's startup_udp()/send_udp()/socket_close() (§7.52), identical fix to ldtx -- same undefined-socket-efun failure breaking the pre-id-prompt encoding_to_mudlist() step on every connection. check_legal_name()'s i%2==0 half-stepping is present but harmless (same as ldtx). Seeded fluffos/Mud2026Adm as (admin) via adm/etc/wizlist -- unlike ldtx, this lib had no pre-existing admin account or README from an earlier pass, so no id collision to work around. One pre-existing, non-blocking content gap left unfixed: d/city/chatroom.lpc's object list references /u/mouse/topten, a wizard directory that doesn't exist anywhere in this archive -- an NPC's heart_beat-driven random_move into this room hits make_inventory() calling new() on the missing file and crashing on the resulting 0->move(), same missing-content class as ldtx's xiaobao.lpc case (and the broader sj.lpc precedent); left as-is rather than fabricate a replacement. Full registration (gb -> id -> confirm -> Chinese name -> password -> confirm -> gift '0' -> accept 'y' -> email -> gender) and look->score->quit verified end-to-end before and after the LPC formatter pass; formatter introduced no corruption (all 3 blind-spot checks clean).
